# What was done

Eight commits on `master` (plan: [20260819-145846_overlay-usability-batch.plan.qmd](20260819-145846_overlay-usability-batch.plan.qmd)):

| Commit | Items |
|--------|-------|
| `7068a8f` feat(group): point-preview dots + single-stroke zone borders | 1, 2 |
| `896c41f` feat(zones): default GroupZones 4x6 + best-fit in-zone derivation | 3, 7 |
| `7df4e85` feat(overlay): vim-style insert mode on plain i, q/Esc to exit | 4 |
| `cc0a049` fix(overlay): snapshot region always closes like one-shot | 5 |
| `b1ea3e6` feat(guide): persistent quadrant guide overlay (I/O/J/K) | 6 |
| `95d7bf7` feat(overlay): resolution-aware badge/leader/match chrome scaling | 8 |
| `1267b18` fix(input): surface UIPI + hotkey-registration failures, dup-instance guard | 9 |
| `f9d60b9` docs+fix: review pass (monitor-relative guide coords, wording) | — |

Key shape of the implementation (details in the plan):

1. **Point dots** — `HintCanvas.RenderGroupVisual` draws one dot per
   `PointHint` at `(br.Left, br.Top)` (the cursor target); re-renders on
   `HintsSource` change.
2. **Single borders** — new `ZoneGridCols/Rows` DPs select a zone-grid path:
   one outer rounded rect (extent + `GroupBoxPad`) + interior separators
   drawn once, same cell math as `TryAssignZoneLabels`. v1 fallback keeps
   per-box outlines.
3. **4×6 zones** — default changed in `OverlayActionConfig`,
   `App.config`, `OptionsViewModel`/`OptionsView`, comments.
4. **Portrait 4×6** — `TryDeriveZoneGrid` now searches the best (c, n/c)
   factorization for `min |c/r − aspect|`; landscape 6×4 and square 5×5
   unchanged, portrait 3×8 → 4×6, 2-char landscape 1×2 → 2×1 (test updated
   with rationale).
5. **Insert mode** — `VK_I` reserved like `VK_Q`; plain `i` → `InsertToggle`
   → `EnterSuspend` (cancels a pending leader; no-op mid-2-pick); the hook
   intercepts plain `q`/`Esc` while suspended → `ExitSuspend`; dim moved
   `<leader>i` → `<leader>x`; `HintCharacters` loses `I` (24 letters;
   24² = 576 = the default grid exactly).
6. **Snapshot close** — `HandleSnapshotCorner` now follows
   `SelectionActionsClose` like `afterSelect` (d/t/v/s all one-shot by
   default).
7. **Quadrant guide** — new code-only `QuadrantGuideWindow` per monitor
   (topmost, click-through, `WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW`, ~30% opacity dotted cross +
   letter pills); `SetClickThrough` refactored into `ForegroundWindow`;
   `QuadrantGuideEnabled/Labels` startup-only config.
8. **Chrome scaling** — `ApplyChromeScale` LayoutTransform
   `clamp(DIU-height/1080, 1, 3)` on badge strip / leader popup / match box.
9. **Elevation** — clicks synthesize via `InputSynthesis.SendMouseEvent`
   (SendInput) with injected-count check → red `INPUT BLOCKED` badge +
   timing-log line; `RegisterHotKey` failures + second-instance exits now
   show a MessageBox; startup logs elevation.

# Verification status

- **Unit tests updated/added** (Rule #0: these verify the pure logic):
  - `GroupViewServiceTest`: portrait → 4×6; new 24-letter landscape/portrait
    facts; small-char-count flipped to 2×1 with rationale comment.
  - `OverlayKeyboardHookTest`: plain `I` → `InsertToggle`; `Shift+I` → Large
    nudge-down (Dx 0, Dy +1); `Ctrl+I`/`Win+I` → `None`.
  - `LeaderBindingConfigTest`: default map has `x=ToggleDim`, no `i`/`q`.
  - `OverlayViewModelTest`: completing both snapshot corners in Continuous
    mode captures a non-degenerate rect AND closes.
- **Compile gate**: CI (windows-latest MSBuild + vstest) — this report is
  written before the push; the run link/status is recorded in the session.
  **I have not compiled locally (Linux box) — CI is the gate.**
- **On-box manual checklist** (user-driven, next): dots + single borders at
  level 1; 4×6 zones; portrait monitor 4×6 in-zone; `i`/`q`/`Esc` insert
  cycle; d/t/v/s close in Continuous; guide cross always visible +
  click-through + hidden under an open overlay; badge/leader ~2× on the 4K
  monitor; elevated v2rayN: single instance + elevated hap → clicks land,
  otherwise the BLOCKED badge/duplicate-instance message names the cause.

# Notes / honest scope

- Item 9's root cause is NOT confirmed from Linux. The duplicate-instance
  mechanism was already guarded by the (previously silent)
  `SingleLaunchMutex`; the new messaging + SendInput failure detection make
  the actual failure legible on-box. If hap truly runs High-IL against a
  High-IL target, UIPI permits SendInput — the new log lines will say so.
- `DoShiftClick`'s internal click pair still uses the array SendInput
  without per-event failure tracking; select pick-1 (always a plain click)
  already detects the blocked case for the select flow.
- Label capacity is now 576 (was 625) — exactly the default grid size, so
  no Grid-mode loss; Automation sessions cap at 576 too.
